# Grid Auto Flow

::: info 实现进度 50% · 进行中
布局 / 字号 / 语义色 helper 已进 SDK。调色盘（gray/red/yellow/green/blue/cyan/indigo/purple/pink 50–900）已写入 `helpers-palette.css`。`hover:` / `focus:` / 全量 `m:` `pc:` 色盘仍缺，所以不能标已完成。
:::

自动摆放方向。`grid-flow-col` 按列填。

```schema
type: page
body:
  - type: tpl
    className: grid grid-flow-col auto-cols-fr h-16 gap-2
    tpl: '<span class="bg-muted p-sm rounded-md">A</span><span class="bg-muted p-sm rounded-md">B</span><span class="bg-muted p-sm rounded-md">C</span>'
```

## 类名

| Class | Properties |
| --- | --- |
| `grid-flow-row` | `grid-auto-flow: row` |
| `grid-flow-col` | `grid-auto-flow: column` |
| `grid-flow-dense` | `grid-auto-flow: dense` |
| `grid-flow-row-dense` | `grid-auto-flow: row dense` |
| `grid-flow-col-dense` | `grid-auto-flow: column dense` |

响应式：`m:` / `pc:` 已接到间距、宽高、display / flex、语义色。状态前缀见 [辅助类-状态样式](/style/state)。
